note: Candidate V5 training recipe (training readiness, 2026-10-19). Nothing here is ratified. The FINAL mode of finetune_v5.py refuses every section whose status is not RATIFIED or APPROVED. Values are recorded in the training preregistration only after owner approval.

base_model.name: TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0
base_model.source: snapshot already used by V4 and by the D63 template measurements

template.source: D63: TinyLlama-Chat structure + owner candidate instruction of 2026-10-13; PROPOSED, not frozen

vocabulary.source: owner pilot choice 2026-10-14 (#70): alternative B; final vocabulary fixed in the dataset preregistration

token_budget.source: D56/D62 provisional max_length and margin; D63 candidate B=415; final values in the preregistration (spec §11.2)

loss.source: V5 candidate: loss on the assistant output + EOS only. V4 trained on the full sequence; 'full_sequence' is kept for parity experiments

quantization.source: D11 (bf16 compute, bf16 training) — environment compatibility decision of the V4 recipe

lora.source: V4-clean recipe values; not re-validated for V5

optimization.source: V4-clean schedule (save_total_limit per D12); epochs/steps for V5 depend on the frozen dataset size

library_pins.source: versions installed for python3.12 on the training machine (E1 port, D11)

smoke.source: engineering smoke settings only; never a V5 training schedule
